name: vtbl
meaning: vtable

name: inst.flags
meaning: Instance flags: 1 drawn/visible last render, 2 (mode bit 5), 4 animated, 8 attached to parent, 0x10 tint override, 0x40 has secondary resource

name: inst.mode
meaning: Instance_InitBase stores its mode argument here: 0xFF ScnBody, 0xFE ScnLogic, or for world objects the WAR resource type (3, 4, 0xB, 0x26). Bit 5 set (0xFE/0xFF/0x26) makes Instance_InitBase set inst flag 2. Game_Frame picks out sky meshes with == 0x26.

name: inst.kind
meaning: 0 = rigid scenaric instance, 4 = animated (set by Animator_Init). World objects use 1/2/3 for resource types 3/0xB/0x26 as the draw-table index (g_worldObjDrawFns); 0 hides a world mesh, and the draw functions skip kind 0.

name: inst.model
meaning: model resource; model+0xc box list {s32 n; Box16[n]}, +0x10 anim table, +0x14 joints (10 B each), +0x18 u16 nbJoints

name: pos
meaning: world position (y down)

name: attachedChildCount
meaning: Also the length of this parent's run of consecutive AttachLink slots in g_attachLinkPool. AttachLink_Alloc appends when it is 0 and inserts after the run otherwise. Instance_DrawAnimParts and Scn_RenderIfVisible walk that many slots from AttachLink_FindFirstChildSlot. Zeroed by Instance_InitFromWarRecord.

name: partHeight
meaning: height in sixteenths (inferred: the classes store value >> 4, e.g. Train 0x80, Wolf 0x100, Bees 0x180); initialised to 0x10

name: rot
meaning: rotation, +0x16 = facing (4096/turn)

name: tintAmount
meaning: colour tint strength 0..0x1000 (0x1000 burnt, 0xC00 shadow zone, glow by distance)

name: tintColor
meaning: tint RGB (0 = black, 0x600060 for glow)

name: tintBytes
meaning: the tint colour's bytes: [0] blue, [1] green, [2] red

name: record
meaning: WAR scenaric record; designer properties at record+0x14

name: attachLink
meaning: parent attachment link (pool of 10 at 0x6e49e0; link+0x18 parent instance, +0x1c parent obj, +0x20 float matrix), NULL when free

name: boundCenter
meaning: model-space bounding centre

name: boundRadius
meaning: bounding half-extent used for render culling

name: secondaryRes
meaning: record u16[1] resource (type 3), set with inst flag 0x40

name: camDist2
meaning: squared distance to camera, written by Scenaric_UpdateAll

name: classId
meaning: ScenaricClassId (0xffff = classless)

name: flags
meaning: ScnObjFlags

name: weight
meaning: Base field. Mass used by seesaw_Update: torque = Σ((axisCoord - centreOnAxis) * weight * contactSpeed) >> 16. Word writes: Wolf_Init 0x4883d1 = 60, Sheep_PostLoadInit 0x47d047 = 40, Robot init 0x461d24 = 40, Rock_Init 0x4e44af = 120, SmallRock 0x4f537b = 120, Snowball 0x4f585c = 120, HoneyPot 0x4ca7cd = 20, Mailbox_Init (on the Mailbox's box objects, not the Mailbox) 0x4d3018 = 60. ScnBody_Init sets 0. Only known reader: seesaw_Update 0x4ec622 (movzx word).

name: pad3e
meaning: tail padding: derived-class fields start at +0x40 (ScnLogic/ScnBody); makes Ghidra print +0x44 as a field, not param_1[1]
